SELECT 
    s.shipment_id,
    s.dispatched_ts,
    s.slot_start,
    s.slot_end,
    s.arrived_ts,
    s.pallets,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.arrived_ts IS NULL THEN 'not_arrived'
        WHEN s.arrived_ts > s.slot_end THEN 'late'
        WHEN s.arrived_ts < s.slot_start THEN 'early'
        ELSE 'on_time'
    END as arrival_status,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.arrived_ts - s.slot_end))/60 as minutes_late
FROM warehouse.shipments s
WHERE s.dispatched_ts >= '2026-07-01' 
  AND s.dispatched_ts < '2026-09-01'
ORDER BY s.dispatched_ts;
